name.value: Pizza Dough Therapy by Ojas Blend

description.value: Pizza Dough Therapy by Ojas Blend is an independent artisan pizza shop on Johnston Road in White Rock, offering an eclectic lineup of globally inspired pies—think jerk chicken and pineapple, palak paneer, and chipotle chorizo alongside classic margherita. The menu is unusually broad for a fast-food format, with a full vegetarian section and vegan cheese available as an add-on. Pickup orders can be placed online, making it a convenient refuelling stop on the White Rock waterfront cycling corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 43m; rack at 52m.

raw_osm.name: Pizza Dough Therapy by Ojas Blend

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at pizzadoughtherapy.com is live and confirms the OSM address (1531 Johnston Rd, White Rock, BC) and that the business is open. The site explicitly lists 'PICKUP Bookings' confirming takeout service, and the menu page includes a dedicated 'VEGGIE MEDLEY' section plus 'VEGAN CHEESE' as an add-on, confirming vegetarian/vegan options. No bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: The website displays the business as 'Dough Therapy' (short form) rather than the full OSM name 'Pizza Dough Therapy by Ojas Blend'; the copyright line reads 'OJAS BLEND INC.' which is consistent with the OSM name.
No phone number is present in either OSM tags or the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active business with a confirmed address, live website, and pickup ordering — a practical food stop for cyclists on the White Rock waterfront route.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes a dedicated 'VEGGIE MEDLEY' section with seven vegetarian pizzas; 'VEGAN CHEESE' and 'NUTRITIONAL YEAST' are listed as add-on options
